archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + RETRO-FUTURIST TACTICAL HACKER

entry_surfaces./: tactical command deck — cyber telemetry banner top, live pool ticker, quick wallet search bar center, live multi-coin grid with real-time hashrate graphs and stratum quick-connect cards
entry_surfaces./coin/:coinId: deep telemetry console — dual column with live hashrate area chart and stratum command generator on left, recent mined blocks & payout stream on right
entry_surfaces./miner/:wallet: personal miner HUD — hashrate history curve, active workers telemetry matrix, unpaid balance meter with one-click payout simulation
entry_surfaces./admin: restricted access terminal — passkey authorization gateway leading to fee rates, stratum ports, RPC nodes, and coin status controls

accessibility.apca_contrast: All text tokens meet AA standards (4.5:1 for body and muted text against respective container backgrounds)
accessibility.aria_labels: All copy buttons, charts, and interactive tables must include meaningful aria-labels

visual_enhancers.scanlines: subtle terminal overlay on stratum code cards: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,255,102,0.03) 0px, transparent 2px, transparent 4px)
visual_enhancers.terminal_prompt: prefix indicators e.g. 'STRATUM://' and 'NODE_OK' with pulse indicators

instructions_to_main_agent: App style: Dark Hacker Terminal / Cyber Command Station for crypto mining pool.
Mobile-first responsive design with US locale formatting (e.g., $ currency values, 12-hour or standard UTC timestamps, commas for thousands separators like 1,420.50 MH/s).
No user login required for miners — miners look up stats simply by pasting their wallet address.
Implement 4 coins: BTC (Bitcoin / SHA-256), LTC (Litecoin / Scrypt), DOGE (Dogecoin / Scrypt), ZANO (Zano / ProgPoWZ).
Ensure pre-seeded mock miner addresses work instantly (provide clickable sample wallet chips near the search input so reviewers can test immediately).

Stratum backend simulation: Show real stratum connection info per coin (stratum+tcp://stratum.minershaven.io:<port>), stratum mining command builders (e.g. xmrig, bzminer, cgminer, lolminer), worker naming rules, and live ping/latency simulation.
Include responsive interactive charts using Recharts (AreaChart for Pool Hashrate & Miner Hashrate with custom tooltip and green/amber glows).

Admin Panel: Protect behind a password prompt (e.g. default 'admin123' / 'minershaven-sec-2026' with display hint for testing). Allow toggling coins, editing pool fee %, changing minimum payout thresholds, stratum ports, and node RPC endpoints with immediate toast notifications.

All interactive elements and metric displays must have robust data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='wallet-search-input', data-testid='wallet-search-button', data-testid='coin-card-btc', data-testid='stratum-copy-button', data-testid='admin-login-button').
Use JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono for all wallet hashes, stratum URLs, ports, block hashes, and difficulty values.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid standard empty generic cards. Fill data grids with rich telemetry (diff, luck %, shares/sec, reject rate %, block reward).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_integrity: Background is deep obsidian #0B0E14, panels #111722, text #F1F5F9, text muted #94A3B8. Neon green #00FF66 and amber #F59E0B are used strategically for data accents and action triggers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications on copy stratum command, wallet lookup, and admin settings save.
